title: A lightweight C Code Generator for Heterogeneous TinyML Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.36907v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Over the past decade, the significant advancements in artificial intelligence have been closely tied to increasingly sophisticated training frameworks and steadily powerful computing hardware. However, the entire ecosystem remains fragmented. On one hand, models are represented with frameworks dependent formats, while on the other hand, new tailored hardware for accelerating novel operators has continued to emerge. To effectively diminish the transfer costs from training to inference, we propose a lightweight C code generator designed for bare-metal heterogeneous systems that incorporate domain-specific accelerators. Through a comprehensive case study on a RISC-V based radar DSP, we demonstrate that by employing an accelerator with ahead-of-time optimizations like weight tuning and bias fusion, our approach achieves a 2.3 times improvement in inference speed and a 20% reduction in binary size compared to the microTVM flow registered with

translated_title: 面向异构TinyML系统的轻量级C代码生成器
translated_abstract: 在过去十年中，人工智能的重大进展与日益复杂的训练框架和不断强大的计算硬件密切相关。然而，整个生态系统仍然处于碎片化状态。一方面，模型以依赖于特定框架的格式表示；另一方面，用于加速新型算子的定制化硬件不断涌现。为了有效降低从训练到推理的迁移成本，我们提出了一种轻量级C代码生成器，专为集成领域专用加速器的裸机异构系统而设计。通过在基于RISC-V的雷达DSP上进行的全面案例研究，我们证明了通过采用带有权重调优和偏置融合等提前优化技术的加速器，与microTVM流程相比，我们的方法实现了2.3倍的推理速度提升和20%的二进制文件体积缩减。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种面向集成领域专用加速器的裸机异构TinyML系统的轻量级C代码生成器，通过权重调优和偏置融合等提前优化技术，在基于RISC-V的雷达DSP上相比microTVM实现了2.3倍推理加速和20%的二进制体积缩减。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a lightweight C code generator for bare-metal heterogeneous TinyML systems with domain-specific accelerators, achieving 2.3x faster inference and 20% smaller binary size compared to microTVM on a RISC-V based radar DSP through ahead-of-time optimizations like weight tuning and bias fusion.
